confirmation.equivalence_rule: if L4096 strings hash-identical to L8192 for >=99% of requests, skip identical requests and run only differing requests
confirmation.pick: single-call L=4096 for PPLX and Jina; unchanged L=8192 reference

definitions.builder_infeasible: budget builder error containing UNBUDGETABLE or BudgetUnavailable:UNBUDGETABLE
definitions.fallback_basis: failed requests score ndcg5_bm25_fallback; R_fallback=100% by construction
definitions.model_valid: valid five distinct original candidate IDs without fallback

experiment: DecisionRAG v3.6 follow-up corrections, full-population timing and frozen confirmation
freeze_statement: All thresholds, cohort choices, policy lists, confirmation pick, seeds, bootstrap definitions and session schedules were frozen before any new outcome or transfer inference.

release_checks.Q: whole-domain bootstrap lower 95% bound of policy-minus-jina_full > -0.02
release_checks.S: same-session p95 ratio; upper 95% bound <=2 pass, lower >2 fail, otherwise inconclusive

quality_bootstrap.method: resample 12 domains with replacement, concatenate selected-domain query differences, query-weighted

release_checks.sign_flip: exact 2^12 domain-mean sign flip; Holm within Q1/Q2 families

model_order: Jina policies then release Jina then PPLX policies

serving_contract.dtype_backend_cache_batch_threads: inherit pinned model registry/runtime; record actual session receipts
serving_contract.fallback_latency_formula: raw latency + measured fallback packaging ms on failed rows only
serving_contract.timed_boundary: prompt construction + native calls + parsing + original-ID mapping + Top-5 packaging
